Frontity 是另一款 WordPress / React 框架。以下供应商: Frontity is a separate WordPress / React framework. The capabilities below were checked against official documentation, without signing in to test the commercial products. Skill examples have separate execution records.
LinkedIn 普通动态发布需先配置应用、完成 OAuth 授权并单独确认。原: Publishing ordinary LinkedIn feed posts requires application configuration, OAuth authorization and separate confirmation. Native Pulse articles and the other four platforms are not yet supported.
https://…；本地文件位置可写在记录里: https://…; put local file locations in the notes
skills 的研究与写作方法；发布工具的账号授权、草稿、审批、排期；GitHu: Research and writing methods from skills; account authorization, drafts, approvals and scheduling from publishing tools; GitHub Issues; existing analytics and data exports.
“任务与分工”“资料与复用库”“历史模块记录”保留原任务和研究／审查记录，反馈页: Tasks & assignments, Resources & reuse, and Historical module records retain the original tasks and research/review records. Feedback remains empty.
“已完成”由执行者按验收条件记录；调研已经写入页面，不会自动把实际运营任务标为完: Executors mark tasks Completed against the acceptance criteria. Research already included on these pages does not automatically complete the operational tasks.
“文档支持”不代表已连通你的账号。试用时先验证输入、输出和限制，再决定购买或接入: Documented support does not mean your account is connected. Verify inputs, outputs and limits before purchasing or integrating a tool; check the provider's current pricing.
下载当前草稿并载入最新版本: Download current draft and load the latest version
临时稿不在备份中，也不会被清理。恢复后仍可读取旧临时稿，继续编辑或确认保存前需显: Temporary drafts are excluded from backups and will not be deleted. After a restore, old drafts remain readable; explicitly create a new temporary draft before editing or confirming them.
从创作页准备资料，修改稿件并确认保存；需要发布时，再到发布页单独确认。: Prepare materials in Creation, edit the draft and confirm saving. When ready to publish, review and confirm separately on the Publishing page.
以下保留早期五步设计作为历史参考。当前流程为创作、发布、反馈；反馈暂留空。: The early five-stage design is retained here for reference. The current flow is Creation, Publishing and Feedback; Feedback remains empty.
任务修改尚未保存，是否放弃？: Task changes have not been saved. Discard them?
保留 {count} 项历史任务、竞品资料与 system1-agents 试跑: Retains {count} historical tasks, competitor research and system1-agents trial examples. Historical examples do not prove that the current execution succeeded.
保留历史五模块与共用支撑任务。点开查看输入、步骤、复用理由和验收条件；实际创作从: Retains tasks for the five historical modules and shared support. Open a task for its inputs, steps, reuse rationale and acceptance criteria. Start actual content work on the Creation page.
保留原五步模板中的资料和记录。当前内容生产从“创作”开始，审核在创作中自动执行。: Retains materials and records from the original five-stage template. Current content production starts in Creation, with review performed automatically within that flow.
保留品牌管理、内容营销产品、发布服务、编排工具和 skills 的历史调研，仍按: Retains historical research on brand management, content marketing products, publishing services, orchestration tools and skills, organized by the original five stages.
先复用，再决定要开发什么。: Reuse first. Then decide what to build.
先完成一条真实内容，再把重复步骤交给 agent。: Complete one real piece of content, then delegate repeatable steps to an agent.
全部工作与复用清单: Complete task and reuse list (Chinese source document)
创作页有编辑等待暂存；切页保留输入。: Creation has edits awaiting temporary save; switching pages preserves your input.
包含 {modules} 个模块、{tasks} 条任务状态。: Contains {modules} modules and {tasks} task status records.
历史记录 · 连接状态见发布页: Historical records · See Publishing for connection status
原调研所用 Agent 环境的技能说明；新执行者需确认对应技能是否可用，本仓库未: Skill instructions from the agent environment used in the original research. The next executor must confirm availability; this repository does not bundle or connect that capability.
双击文件夹里的“启动工作台.cmd”。浏览器会自动打开。: Double-click “启动工作台.cmd” in the folder. Your browser will open automatically.
反馈中的问题和证据，回到下一轮研究 ↩: Questions and evidence from feedback inform the next research cycle ↩
发布记录按合并保留策略恢复；旧备份不会清除现有发布事实或防重记录。恢复不会发送帖: Publishing records are merged and retained on restore. Older backups cannot erase existing publication facts or duplicate-prevention records. Restoring does not send posts or restore account secrets or authorization credentials. Restore is blocked while a publication is submitting; wait for completion and check its result.
另含 {count} 份正式内容及其历史版本和已保存素材，将恢复成备份中的集合。: Also contains {count} saved content items, their version history and saved assets. The active collection will be restored to the backup. Current items absent from the backup will be removed from the active library and retained in the pre-restore snapshot.
可以并行交给五位执行者: Work packages for five parallel executors
可使用上传的 PNG / JPEG；自动配图连接情况以页面为准。DOCX 导出与: Uploaded PNG / JPEG images can be used; the page shows whether automatic image generation is connected. DOCX export and feedback collection are not yet implemented.
在“创作”填写产品资料／已有内容、写作目的和目标读者；资料可上传 .txt /: In Creation, provide product materials or existing content, the writing purpose and the target audience. You can upload .txt / .md source files.
在“发布”连接 LinkedIn 账号，选择正式版本，核对预览并单独确认发布。保: In Publishing, connect your LinkedIn account, select a saved version, check the preview and confirm publication separately. Saving content never posts it automatically.
复用现有方法或服务，减少重复搭建；先用一条真实内容验证是否节省操作和维护成本。: Reuse existing methods or services to avoid rebuilding them. Test one real piece of content to see whether this reduces operating and maintenance work.
外部账号操作按任务授权与平台规则执行；实际连接与发布结果请在发布页核对。: Perform external account actions within the task's authorization and platform rules. Check actual connection and publication results on the Publishing page.
完成后，补充成果链接。: Add the result link when the work is complete.
完整竞品与复用调研: Full competitor and reuse research (Chinese source document)
将方法、输入和结果写清楚，让下一位执行者能接手。: Describe the method, inputs and results clearly so the next executor can take over.
已接入文字生成、自动审核和修订流程；实际可用性与执行结果以创作页为准。: Text generation, automatic review and revision are connected. The Creation page shows actual availability and execution results.
打开稿件，直接编辑段落或提交局部改稿意见。编辑先暂存，点击“确认保存此版本”才进: Open a draft to edit paragraphs directly or request a targeted revision. Edits are saved temporarily; only Confirm and save this version adds them to the saved content library.
按官方技能说明准备输入，由现有 agent 执行；在任务卡保存结果。未验证的连接: Prepare inputs according to the official skill instructions and run them with an available agent. Save results in the task card. Trial unverified connections manually first.
按笔记中的品牌管理语境，这里核查 Frontify。: The brand-management context in the notes refers to Frontify.
搜索工作、部分或复用工具: Search tasks, sections or reusable tools
支持中英文 LinkedIn 普通动态的固定规则、段落编辑、局部提案、暂存及正式: Supports fixed rules for Chinese and English LinkedIn feed posts, paragraph editing, targeted proposals, temporary drafts and saved version history.
数据留在本机 · 先复用，后自动化: Data stays local · Reuse first, automate later
旧备份不含正式内容，现有正式内容及其历史版本会保留。: This older backup contains no saved content. Existing saved content and its version history will be retained.
有证据再增加: Add capabilities when evidence supports them
未核实原生能力；不推断支持: Native capability unverified; support is not assumed
本地版适合同一台电脑维护总台账。其他人通过任务包和成果文件交接；它不提供多台电脑: The local edition maintains the master records on one computer. Others hand off task packages and result files; it does not provide real-time synchronization across computers.
本地界面只监听本机地址；不要把它直接暴露到公网。: The local interface listens only on this computer. Do not expose it directly to the public internet.
本地运行与交接指南: Local operation and handoff guide (Chinese source document)
本模块从项目资料开始。: This module starts with project materials.
查看资料和编辑台账无需联网；打开外部来源、使用在线模型及发布工具需要网络，并受各: Viewing materials and editing records work offline. External sources, online models and publishing tools require a network connection and are subject to each service's rules and charges.
核对本次平台、语言和格式后生成。工作台调用已接入的模型，执行初稿、一次审核和修订: Check the platforms, languages and formats for this run before generating. The workspace uses the connected model to draft, review once and revise; failures show the actual reason.
模块与任务记录保存在本机 data 文件夹；JSON 备份用于换电脑或恢复。已确: Module and task records are stored in the local data folder. JSON backups support migration and recovery. Saved content and selected assets are included; temporary drafts are not. Result links do not include the external files themselves.
模块修改尚未保存，是否放弃？: Module changes have not been saved. Discard them?
模型失败、账号未连接或结果未知时均会明确显示；页面不会把这些状态当作成功。: Model failures, disconnected accounts and unknown results are shown explicitly; the interface does not treat them as successes.
每一项工作，都可以交接。: Every task can be handed off.
没有找到资源，试试更短的关键词。: No resources found. Try a shorter keyword.
点击“备份数据”保留副本；工作结束可双击“停止工作台.cmd”。: Choose Back up data to keep a copy. When finished, double-click “停止工作台.cmd”.
自动触发、跨工具同步、重试和提醒。连续重复且规则稳定后，从 n8n、Gumloo: Automatic triggers, synchronization across tools, retries and reminders. Once steps repeat consistently with stable rules, choose among n8n, Gumloop and Relevance AI.
资料入口、模块说明、任务分工、执行记录、成果链接、任务导出、持久化和备份。所有账: Material entry points, module instructions, task assignments, execution notes, result links, task exports, persistence and backups. Account actions are performed by executors or connected tools.
输入待补充，请提供上游成果链接或直接粘贴材料。: Input needed: provide the upstream result link or paste the materials directly.
边界：先复用现有 skill 与工具。未接入的外部操作不要假称完成。仅交付本模块: Scope: reuse existing skills and tools first. Never claim an unconnected external action is complete. Deliver this module only, with sources, execution records and open questions for the handoff.
这会恢复模块、任务及备份包含的正式内容；恢复前会自动保留快照。: This restores modules, tasks and saved content included in the backup. A pre-restore snapshot is created automatically.
页面管交接，工具做擅长的事。: The workspace manages handoffs; tools do what they do best.
首版不要重复开发: Do not rebuild in the first version
无法连接本地服务。请重新启动工作台。: Unable to connect to the local service. Restart the workspace.
任务已复制，可交给其他人或 agent。: Task copied. You can hand it to another person or agent.
复制不可用，已下载任务文件。: Clipboard unavailable. The task file was downloaded.
保存失败，输入仍保留。: Save failed. Your input has been preserved.
已导出全部任务、当前负责人和执行记录。: Exported all tasks, current owners and execution notes.
原草稿已下载，编辑器已载入最新记录，请合并后保存。: The original draft was downloaded and the latest record loaded. Merge your changes before saving.
读取失败，原输入仍保留。: Read failed. Your original input has been preserved.
备份超过 16 MB，请核对文件。: The backup exceeds 16 MB. Check the file.
这不是本工作台的版本 1 备份。: This is not a version 1 backup for this workspace.
备份已恢复，恢复前的数据已另存快照。: Backup restored. The previous data was saved in a separate snapshot.
